name: validateexpr-28
caseXml:
<ns0:test-case xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2010/09/qt-fots-catalog" name="validateexpr-28">
      <ns0:description>name: validateexpr-28 description: Test Bug 5223, [XPath] Casting rules in 3.5.2 General Comparisons (editorial) </ns0:description>
      <ns0:created by="Norm Walsh" on="2010-03-11" />
      <ns0:modified by="O'Neil Delpratt" on="2011-09-07" change="Referenced the schema in environment. Removed unused variable input-context1" />
      <ns0:modified by="O'Neil Delpratt" on="2011-10-14" change="Environment tag moved before dependency. Bug #14461" />
      <ns0:environment ref="xq-e18xsd" />
      <ns0:dependency type="spec" value="XQ10+" />
      <ns0:test>
        import schema namespace t="http://www.example.com/ns/test/xq-e18";
        let $doc := validate strict { document { <doc xmlns="http://www.example.com/ns/test/xq-e18"> <para1>PT3H21M</para1> <para2>P3M</para2> </doc> } } let $p1 := data($doc/t:doc/t:para1) let $p2 := data($doc/t:doc/t:para2) let $t1 := xs:dayTimeDuration("PT3H21M") let $t2 := xs:yearMonthDuration("P3M") return <results> <case1>{if ($p1 = $t1) then "pass" else "fail"}</case1> <case2>{if ($p2 = $t2) then "pass" else "fail"}</case2> </results>
      </ns0:test>
      <ns0:result>
         <ns0:any-of>
            <ns0:assert-xml><results><case1>pass</case1><case2>pass</case2></results></ns0:assert-xml>
            <ns0:error code="XQST0012" />
         </ns0:any-of>
      </ns0:result>
   </ns0:test-case>
environmentXml:
<ns0:environment xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2010/09/qt-fots-catalog" name="xq-e18xsd">
      <ns0:schema uri="http://www.example.com/ns/test/xq-e18" file="ValidateExpr/xq-e18.xsd">
         <ns0:description>A schema for simple context tests.</ns0:description>
         <ns0:created by="Anonymous" on="2005-12-07" />
      </ns0:schema>
   </ns0:environment>

name: substitution-020
caseXml:
<ns0:test-case xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2010/09/qt-fots-catalog" name="substitution-020" covers-30="substitution-groups xsd11">
      <ns0:description>XSD 1.1: element in more than one substitution group.
        Not a member, because abstract.</ns0:description>
      <ns0:created by="Michael Kay" on="2012-10-10" />
      <ns0:environment ref="substitution11" />
      <ns0:dependency type="spec" value="XQ30+" />
      <ns0:dependency type="xsd-version" value="1.1" />
      <ns0:test>
        import schema namespace s="http://www.w3.org/XQueryTest/substitution11"; 
        declare variable $in :=
            validate strict {
              <cuckoo xmlns="http://www.w3.org/XQueryTest/substitution11">
                <A/>
              </cuckoo>            
            }; 
        $in/s:A instance of schema-element(s:H1)
      </ns0:test>
      <ns0:result>
         <ns0:assert-false />
      </ns0:result>
   </ns0:test-case>
